title: Practice: How long, how long ago, how old

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: He advanced his departure by two days.
exercises.why: The person whose age is in question is in the dative case. The preposition НА + Acc. is used: (a) to indicate the length of time one expects to stay some place, or the time something is expected to last; (b) after the verb опаздывать / опоздать to indicate the amount of time by which someone is late. — DLI, Lesson 41.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: The person whose age is in question is in the dative case. (DLI, Lesson 41)
